## We do things a little differently. Here's what sets us apart.

At Massage Envy, we offer total body care, personalized experiences, and exceptional service to help
you feel your best. As an added touch, we always provide helpful recommendations for at-home care to
guide you on your wellness journey.

### Whole-body wellness philosophy

We’ve got self-care covered from head to toe! Look and feel your best with a blend of therapeutic
massage, assisted stretch, facials, and advanced skin services.

### Every body is welcome here

The brand’s aim is to make amazing self-care available to everyone. Franchised locations are
designed to be warm and inviting from the moment you arrive.

### Depth of experience

Massage Envy was founded in 2002 by a massage therapist. Participating franchised locations began
offering facials in 2008, and assisted stretch was added in 2017.

### Membership that makes self-care easier

A Massage Envy membership is an investment in what’s most important: YOU. It includes a monthly
Wellness Session that helps you make ME time a regular thing, plus discounts on additional sessions
and more (Terms apply).

## We do things a little differently. Here's what sets us apart.

At Massage Envy, we offer total body care, personalized experiences, and exceptional service to help
you feel your best. As an added touch, we always provide helpful recommendations for at-home care to
guide you on your wellness journey.

### Whole-body wellness philosophy

We’ve got self-care covered from head to toe! Look and feel your best with a blend of therapeutic
massage, assisted stretch, facials, and advanced skin services.

### Every body is welcome here

The brand’s aim is to make amazing self-care available to everyone. Franchised locations are
designed to be warm and inviting from the moment you arrive.

### Depth of experience

Massage Envy was founded in 2002 by a massage therapist. Participating franchised locations began
offering facials in 2008, and assisted stretch was added in 2017.

### Membership that makes self-care easier

A Massage Envy membership is an investment in what’s most important: YOU. It includes a monthly
Wellness Session that helps you make ME time a regular thing, plus discounts on additional sessions
and more (Terms apply).

## Wellness, delivered™

Soothe is a marketplace that connects individuals and businesses with highly-rated independent
professionals offering massage, skincare, hair, and beauty services.

[ Book Now ][43]

## In-Home Services

Enjoy the ease of bringing wellness professionals right to your door! With the Soothe app, you can
easily book services with your preferred provider and schedule them at a time and place that works
best for you.

Get even more value by joining SoothePass®, our monthly membership, and make wellness a consistent
part of your healthy lifestyle, all while saving on every service.

[ Learn More ][44]
[Soothe Client App][Soothe Client App]

## Spa & Hospitality Solutions

Ensure guests always receive exceptional service while maximizing revenue. Simply post available
shifts to pre-approved, independent, licensed wellness professionals in the marketplace and
seamlessly expand during peak times without hiring additional staff.

Don’t have a spa? No problem! Access a network of top-rated licensed massage therapists and wellness
professionals to provide on-demand services that guests and residents will love.

[ Learn More ][45]

## Employee Wellness Solutions

Attract and retain top talent by providing wellness programs that reflect your company’s culture and
values. Designed to support both in-office and remote employees, Soothe’s nationwide network
guarantees access to reliable, high-quality wellness services, no matter where your team is located.

[ Learn More ][46]
[Office Chair Massage][Office Chair Massage]

## Soothe Provider Community

Soothe enables you to grow your business on your terms — set your availability and service areas,
manage your appointments and earning potential, and much more — all via the Soothe Pro app.

[ Learn More ][47]

## Refer a friend to Soothe, get $50*

Know someone who would love Soothe? Share the love.

They’ll get $50 off by using your code at checkout, and when they complete their first appointment,
you get $50. This is one of our best deals yet!

[ Invite Friends ][48]

****Referral program access and sharing are available exclusively through the Soothe app.***

### [Sauna, Steam Bath and Jacuzzi System][53]

[Read more][54]

Established in 2003, not only do we pride ourselves on distributing quality and reasonably priced
salon & home care products in the beauty industry, we are also known for our great customer service
standards. To date, we have supplied over 300 beauty salons, including home based ones in Singapore
and Johor, Malaysia. All our skin care product brands from France, USA, Switzerland and Japan focus
on using only natural minerals and botanical extracts as key ingredients, unveiling the natural
active ingredients that provide great aesthetic effects to enhance the natural beauty of both women
and men. We offer more than 200 types of products, including cleansers, toners, soft masks,
ampoules, anti-ageing & whitening products and massage cream, as well as disposable items such as
face masks and bed sheets etc for beauty salons to choose from. 

In the recent few years, we have expanded our services to include sale & repair of
manufacturing of OEM skin care products, beauty equipment, supply, installation, maintenance and
repair of sauna system, steam bath system and jacuzzi system. Our dedication and professionalism in
this area has won the hearts of many beauty salons and even residences such as condominium councils
and home owners. As our company continue to grow and bring in newer & better products as well as
service to meet the market’s changing needs, we urge you to give our products and services a try,
simply because we give you only the best.

ampoules, anti-ageing & whitening products and massage cream, as well as disposable items such as

## Почему выбирают Афину

Турбаза Афина расположена в экологически чистой природной зоне на берегу реки Ахтубы. Чистый воздух,
сосновый лес, современный СПА-комплекс и уютные коттеджи — всё в 45 минутах от Волгограда.

Волго-Ахтубинская пойма
Экологически чистая зона, сосновый лес, чистый воздух круглый год
Собственный СПА-комплекс
3 закрытых бассейна, турецкий хамам, джакузи и соляная комната
Коттеджи для любой компании
От уютных номеров до двухэтажного коттеджа на 14 человек с баней
Кафе с домашней кухней
Завтраки, обеды и ужины на территории. Мангальные зоны для барбекю
Рыбалка на берегу Ахтубы
Прямой доступ к берегу, рыбалка и водные развлечения
Безопасная охраняемая территория
Круглосуточная охрана, видеонаблюдение, закрытая территория

### about us

## At adona spaLodge

Since 2013, adona Spa Lodge in Addis Ababa has been a place where care becomes an experience. The
name adona, meaning "My Mother," embodies the warmth, protection, and devotion of a mother's
love—guiding every touch, every ritual, and every moment we create. Here, wellness is not just a
service; it is a feeling, a choice, and a lifestyle.

We invite our guests to move beyond reactive care, embracing practices that nourish the body, calm
the mind, and awaken vitality. Every visit is an invitation to reclaim balance, embrace health, and
carry the serenity of the spa into everyday life.

At adona spaLodge, we cultivate a world of splendid beauty and a relaxation lifestyle, where each
moment lingers, each experience restores, and every guest leaves renewed.

Retreat to Banyan Tree Hotels, destinations of extraordinary beauty and meaningful connection.

the transformative power of travel as it awakens and inspires.

## Discover our destinations

[BT Mayakoba][BT Mayakoba]


### Riviera Maya, Mexico

Nestled within a private gated community linked by canal waterways, Banyan Tree Mayakoba offers
timeless design in harmony with an arcadia of surrounding untouched nature.

[Explore More][20]
[MRR Singapore][MRR Singapore]


### Singapore

Escape the urban jungle and awaken in the rainforest. Nestled within Mandai Wildlife Reserve, this
sanctuary in a city offers conscious stays amidst the trees.

[Explore More][21]
[BT SAMUI][BT SAMUI]


### Samui, Thailand

Retreat to the secluded haven of Banyan Tree Samui, where every villa has its own private pool,
perfect for maximizing relaxation and uplifting the senses.

[Explore More][22]
[Krabi][Krabi]


### Krabi, Thailand

Find peace and comfort in our idyllic beachfront resort of Banyan Tree Krabi, where every suite or
villa offers mesmerizing views of the Andaman sea.

[Explore More][23]
[BT Vabbinfaru][BT Vabbinfaru]


### North Malé Atoll, Maldives

Banyan Tree Vabbinfaru brings Maldivian culture to life through sensory journeys, from signature
rituals to locally inspired culinary experiences crafted with fresh, local ingredients.

[Explore More][24]
[BT Lang Co ][BT Lang Co ]


### Lăng Cô, Vietnam

Banyan Tree Lăng Cô is a beachside paradise of luxurious all-pool villas, nestled between the East
Sea and the Truong Son mountain range.

[Explore More][25]
[BT PHUKET][BT PHUKET]


### Phuket, Thailand

Banyan Tree Phuket offers a uniquely luxurious pool villa resort experience as you explore local
culture, restore inner peace, and progress your personal wellness journey.

[Explore More][26]
[BT Bintan][BT Bintan]


### Bintan, Indonesia

Set on stilts by the hillside, Banyan Tree Bintan offers a sense of serenity surrounded by ancient
rainforests and views of the South China Sea.

[Explore More][27]
[BT KYOTO][BT KYOTO]


### Kyoto, Japan

Perched in Kyoto's Gion and Higashiyama district, Banyan Tree Kyoto offers 52 luxurious rooms with
stunning city views, a Noh stage, and natural hot springs.

[Explore More][28]
[BT Shanghai Night View][BT Shanghai Night View]


### Shanghai, China

In the sprawling metropolis of Shanghai is one of the world's largest cities, with a vibrant urban
life, impressive skyline and rich culture. Right in the middle of all this, on the bank of the
Huangpu River, lies Banyan Tree Shanghai On The Bund, an urban retreat in the city's most scenic
location

[Explore More][29]
[BT Bangkok][BT Bangkok]


### Bangkok, Thailand

Banyan Tree Bangkok is the only 5-star all-suite hotel in the metropolitan, multicultural city of
Bangkok, offering a high-rise luxurious oasis amidst bustling cityscapes, exotic street food, and
endless shopping.

[Explore More][30]
[BT Cabo Marques][BT Cabo Marques]


### Cabo Marqués, Mexico

Be entranced by Acapulco with its stunning sunsets, famous cliffs and captivating ocean views, at
our AAA Five Diamond Award resort, Banyan Tree Cabo Marqués.

[Explore More][31]
[BT Veya][BT Veya]


### Baja California, México

Discover the abundance of Baja California, Mexico's wine country in Banyan Tree Veya Valle de
Guadalupe, and find tranquility in a bespoke vineyard sanctuary.

[Explore More][32]

natural habitat.

by our chefs, from authentic local dishes to innovative tasting menus, as you embark on
international gastronomic journeys that take you deeper into culture.

contemporary therapies, offering signature treatments, holistic healing rituals and tranquil spaces
that enhance your overall wellbeing.

mind.

## Discover our destinations

[BT Mayakoba][BT Mayakoba]


### Riviera Maya, Mexico

Nestled within a private gated community linked by canal waterways, Banyan Tree Mayakoba offers
timeless design in harmony with an arcadia of surrounding untouched nature.

[Explore More][20]
[MRR Singapore][MRR Singapore]


### Singapore

Escape the urban jungle and awaken in the rainforest. Nestled within Mandai Wildlife Reserve, this
sanctuary in a city offers conscious stays amidst the trees.

[Explore More][21]
[BT SAMUI][BT SAMUI]


### Samui, Thailand

Retreat to the secluded haven of Banyan Tree Samui, where every villa has its own private pool,
perfect for maximizing relaxation and uplifting the senses.

[Explore More][22]
[Krabi][Krabi]


### Krabi, Thailand

Find peace and comfort in our idyllic beachfront resort of Banyan Tree Krabi, where every suite or
villa offers mesmerizing views of the Andaman sea.

[Explore More][23]
[BT Vabbinfaru][BT Vabbinfaru]


### North Malé Atoll, Maldives

Banyan Tree Vabbinfaru brings Maldivian culture to life through sensory journeys, from signature
rituals to locally inspired culinary experiences crafted with fresh, local ingredients.

[Explore More][24]
[BT Lang Co ][BT Lang Co ]


### Lăng Cô, Vietnam

Banyan Tree Lăng Cô is a beachside paradise of luxurious all-pool villas, nestled between the East
Sea and the Truong Son mountain range.

[Explore More][25]
[BT PHUKET][BT PHUKET]


### Phuket, Thailand

Banyan Tree Phuket offers a uniquely luxurious pool villa resort experience as you explore local
culture, restore inner peace, and progress your personal wellness journey.

[Explore More][26]
[BT Bintan][BT Bintan]


### Bintan, Indonesia

Set on stilts by the hillside, Banyan Tree Bintan offers a sense of serenity surrounded by ancient
rainforests and views of the South China Sea.

[Explore More][27]
[BT KYOTO][BT KYOTO]


### Kyoto, Japan

Perched in Kyoto's Gion and Higashiyama district, Banyan Tree Kyoto offers 52 luxurious rooms with
stunning city views, a Noh stage, and natural hot springs.

[Explore More][28]
[BT Shanghai Night View][BT Shanghai Night View]


### Shanghai, China

In the sprawling metropolis of Shanghai is one of the world's largest cities, with a vibrant urban
life, impressive skyline and rich culture. Right in the middle of all this, on the bank of the
Huangpu River, lies Banyan Tree Shanghai On The Bund, an urban retreat in the city's most scenic
location

[Explore More][29]
[BT Bangkok][BT Bangkok]


### Bangkok, Thailand

Banyan Tree Bangkok is the only 5-star all-suite hotel in the metropolitan, multicultural city of
Bangkok, offering a high-rise luxurious oasis amidst bustling cityscapes, exotic street food, and
endless shopping.

[Explore More][30]
[BT Cabo Marques][BT Cabo Marques]


### Cabo Marqués, Mexico

Be entranced by Acapulco with its stunning sunsets, famous cliffs and captivating ocean views, at
our AAA Five Diamond Award resort, Banyan Tree Cabo Marqués.

[Explore More][31]
[BT Veya][BT Veya]


### Baja California, México

Discover the abundance of Baja California, Mexico's wine country in Banyan Tree Veya Valle de
Guadalupe, and find tranquility in a bespoke vineyard sanctuary.

[Explore More][32]

#### OPENING AUGUST 2026


Ubuyu, a Banyan Tree Escape, is an invitation to rewild your soul. An intimate safari retreat set in
the untouched nature of Ruaha National Park. Here, expansive, artisan-crafted villas overlook the
Great Ruaha River. Harmoniously woven into the open savannah, where animals roam freely in their
natural habitat.

## Exclusive Offers

Uncover the beauty of nature, rich culture and unique gastronomy with our special offers at Banyan
Tree Hotels and Resorts. From spa and dining packages to seasonal retreats and family getaways,
discover international escapes at our hotels.

[Explore][34]
[Meetings][Meetings]

### Meetings that Inspire

Wrap up a meeting and step onto a buzzing backstreet awash with friendly bars and eateries alive
with locals. Host spectacular galas that exude the spirit of the destination. Whether a formal
presentation or casual gathering of colleagues, foster connections and elevate your event at our
global hotels.

[Read More][35]
[Culinary experiences][Culinary experiences]

### Culinary Experiences at Banyan Tree

From breezy coastal menus to fine-dining charms at our urban retreats, Banyan Tree Hotels highlight
the culinary traditions of each destination. Savour rich flavours and seasonal specialties crafted
by our chefs, from authentic local dishes to innovative tasting menus, as you embark on
international gastronomic journeys that take you deeper into culture.

[Read More][36]
[Banyan Tree spa][Banyan Tree spa]

### Banyan Tree Spa

Relax in the multisensory oasis of our award-winning Banyan Tree Spas, designed to rejuvenate mind,
body and spirit. A hallmark of our global hotels, every spa blends traditional practices with
contemporary therapies, offering signature treatments, holistic healing rituals and tranquil spaces
that enhance your overall wellbeing.

[Read More][37]

## Banyan Tree Wellbeing Sanctuary

Start your journey of renewal with our Wellbeing Sanctuaries – signature stay programmes at Banyan
Tree Hotels designed for those beginning their path of wellbeing. Nourishing cuisines, exceptional
natural environments, spa therapies and curated activities restore and strengthen both body and
mind.

[Explore][38]
[Wellbeing activities][Wellbeing activities]

From mood-setting candles and room sprays to moisturising body lotions and face creams, Banyan Tree
Essentials capture moments of peace and renewal.

speedboat trip of Baros, some of which are ranked among the top ten dive sites in the Maldives. Also
available at our Eco Dive Centre (one of the first of its kind in the Maldives), is the
revolutionary Fluo night diving experience.

yogas sessions and private dining experiences to memorable dhoni cruises along the turquoise waters
of the lagoon and starlit cinema offerings — a trip to Baros is bound to live on in your mind long
after the flight home.

colours, fish, turtles, rays and living coral. It is believed to be one of the healthiest and best
reefs of the Maldives.

genuine, heartfelt Maldivian hospitality.

at Baros Luxury Resort][Private Beach view at Baros Luxury Resort]

# Award-Winning Services

Nominated as Portland’s Favorite Eco-Friendly Spa, Blooming Moon offers all-natural alternatives,
cruelty-free product lines, quality services and an individualized approach to spa treatments.
Located in the heart of Portland Oregon’s Overlook neighborhood (1417 N. Shaver St.), Blooming Moon
Wellness Spa provides; organic and advanced skincare (hydrafacial, holistic facials, microcurrent
and effective peels) body scrubs, relaxing massage services (aromatherapy, pregnancy, deep tissue,
hot stone and more), hair removal, deluxe signature pedicures and manicures and more. Enjoy a
one-of-a-kind experience and reserve the retreat studio for a private soak and steam! Include a
self-guided facial and/or body scrub flight with your soak and steam for some extra pampering.

The spa’s mission is to provide the best spa treatments in Portland, while simultaneously nurturing
the staff. With these principles, we hope to deliver the best service possible, every time.

We look forward to providing you a first-class spa experience!

# Find Your Blissful Escape

## A European-Style Spa & Wellness Retreat

Voted one of the "Top 10 Best Spas in the World" by the Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards,
Cal-a-Vie Health Spa offers an intimate and gorgeous self-care hideaway designed for the mind, body,
and spirit. Nestled between vast fields of grapevines with stunning views, discover an elegantly
life-changing wellness retreat. This is Cal-a-Vie Health Spa.

Devoted to Your Wellbeing
[Array]

## Endless Amenities & Activities

Cal-a-Vie Health Spa is a destination like none other. Explore meditation techniques, culinary
demonstrations, spa treatments, fitness classes, beauty services, and much more.

[a woman posing in front of a wall with art]

## Tailor-Made for Every Guest

From pickleball games and nutritious cooking classes to candlelit yoga and hikes through nature, our
team creates customized schedules for each guest to experience.

[Array]

## Refined French Elegance in California

Combining European spa philosophies with the Californian concepts of fitness, health, and nutrition,
Cal-a-Vie Health Spa creates a new standard of beauty and elegance.

## The Pillars that Guide Us
* ### Hedonistic Wellness
  
  Revitalization of mind, body, and spirit should be as healthy as it is satisfying.
* ### Biophilic Design
  
  Nature is woven into the built environment to support the mind, body, and soul.
* ### Meaningful Experiences
  
  The best moments become the ones we return to for years.
* ### Bespoke Sustainability
  
  The most sustainable products are tailored to everyday lifestyles.
* ### Evocative Art
  
  Art deepens our understanding of shared human experience.
* ### Nourishing Food
  
  Food should be as good for your soul as it is for your body.

# Beijing Daxing International Airport

The Biggest Airport in the World
[ ; ][27]

## **Beijing Daxing Airport is Finally Open**

**Beijing Daxing International Airport (PKX)**, also known as Beijing New Airport, is the airport
featuring the second largest single-building terminal in the world. It opened its doors on September
26, 2019, and is a multi-awarded airport. It is also the second international airport in Beijing.
Indeed, Beijing Daxing Airport and Beijing Capital International Airport are the two international
aviation hubs of the Chinese capital, as the adjacent Beijing Nanyuan Airport closed once the new
airport began its operation.

The airport’s design is pioneering. Designed by the renowned architect Zaha Hadid, the terminal is
spread over 700,000m² (7,500,000 sq ft) and is considered a state of art. Moreover, PKX Airport
boasts 4 runways (as well as one military runway) and an impressive number of 82 boarding gates. On
the other hand, its location in Daxing District (the southern suburbs of Beijing) is ideal for
serving the Chinese capital and the neighboring areas of Hebei and Tianjin. The new mega-airport hub
served more than 39.4 million passengers in 2023 and is expected to reach an outstanding 100 million
passenger flow in the future. 

**Daxing Airport** is located at the frontier between Beijing and Langfang, Hebei Province, and
serves the needs of Beijing, Tianjin, and Hebei areas. Its location was selected after thorough
analysis. It is actually located between Yufa Town and Lixian Town in the Daxing District of Beijing
and the Guangyang District of Langfang in the Province of Hebei. With a 46km/28.5-mile distance from
Tiananmen Square, a 67km/41.6-mile distance from Beijing International Airport, and a 26km/16.1-mile
distance from Langfang City Center, Daxing Airport aims to become the main airport hub of the
region.

## MOTHERHOOD & SERVICE, IT ALL BEGINS HERE!

ELGEL HOTEL AND SPA is a newly established Four Star Hotel located in Addis Abeba the capital and
diplomatic seat of Ethiopia.

ELGEL HOTEL AND SPA offers high-end facilities with premium services to our guests. With our
different outlets, our guests can have a unique experience and pleasure throughout their stay with
us.

## What makes ELGEL unique?

ELGEL HOTEL AND SPA is the premier hotel for this rare and beautiful natural wonder, where you can
have out of city experience at within Addis.

ELGEL HOTEL AND SPA has an Indoor Swimming Pool, Bar & BBQ area, Restaurant, Cultural Restaurant, a
24-hour Front Desk, Room Service, Laundry, Pastry & Bakery, Gym, Sauna, and Steam along with free
Wi-Fi throughout the property. Our own ELGEL’s VIEW Grill-strategically located towards the green
forest view and eye-catching landscape is a must to see and feel the experience– also we have a
playground for the little ones.

There is a free private parking and the property provides free shuttle service from and to the
airport.

The rooms comes with, electronic card sensor switch, a flat-screen with IP TV channels, an electric
teapot/kettle, box shower, a hairdryer and writing table and chair. Some of the rooms have Garden
view, and others have city view.

*All these elements make ELGEL a unique Hotel establishment in Addis!*

ELGEL HOTEL AND SPA is a newly established Four Star Hotel located in Addis Abeba the capital and
diplomatic seat of Ethiopia.

ELGEL HOTEL AND SPA offers high-end facilities with premium services to our guests. With our

## What makes ELGEL unique?

ELGEL HOTEL AND SPA is the premier hotel for this rare and beautiful natural wonder, where you can
have out of city experience at within Addis.

ELGEL HOTEL AND SPA has an Indoor Swimming Pool, Bar & BBQ area, Restaurant, Cultural Restaurant, a
24-hour Front Desk, Room Service, Laundry, Pastry & Bakery, Gym, Sauna, and Steam along with free
Wi-Fi throughout the property. Our own ELGEL’s VIEW Grill-strategically located towards the green
forest view and eye-catching landscape is a must to see and feel the experience– also we have a
playground for the little ones.

There is a free private parking and the property provides free shuttle service from and to the
airport.

The rooms comes with, electronic card sensor switch, a flat-screen with IP TV channels, an electric
teapot/kettle, box shower, a hairdryer and writing table and chair. Some of the rooms have Garden
view, and others have city view.

*All these elements make ELGEL a unique Hotel establishment in Addis!*

escape at La Samaritaine, with a 3-hour private session with a personal stylist in the heart of the
Appartement de La Samaritaine.

### Hotel Balzac by Festen

Charlotte de Tonnac and Hugo Sauzay, the duo behind Festen Architecture, have transformed Hotel
Balzac into a unique destination, blending grand hotel spirit with intimate chic. Inspired by the
hotel's facade and architectural details, they created a distinctive atmosphere while honoring its
history and heritage. From the glass-roofed lounge to the rooms and spa, the spaces offer a cozy and
welcoming ambiance. Neutral tones, clean lines, and refined materials such as wood, velvet, and
natural stone create timeless elegance. Light, considered as a true element of decoration, enhances
the space throughout the day. Custom-made furniture, reminiscent of the 1930s and 40s, is
reinterpreted with creative modernity and a constant focus on comfort. Every detail of this
renovation echoes Balzac's Parisian identity. "Balzac perpetuates a timeless Parisian hotel heritage
with its classicism. It's a place full of atmosphere, with a history that we have respected and
extended. You need to experience this place to understand it," say Charlotte de Tonnac and Hugo
Sauzay.

# Vivre Paris

Just steps from the Champs-Élysées, Hôtel Balzac is a discreet haven, a vibrant historical site
reborn after a complete renovation envisioned by Festen Architecture. It invites you to live a
chapter of your own story in an exclusive Parisian setting, elegant and forever romantic.

[[image]][5] [[image]][6] [[image]][7] [[image]][8] [[image]][9]


## Rooms & Suites Sheltered from the world

Sleek spaces, luxurious materials, and artistic lighting define our 58 rooms and suites, each a
haven inspired by the understated elegance of the 1930s. These cocoons offer a retreat where you can
rejuvenate while taking in the Parisian life. Some rooms boast views of the Eiffel Tower, and the
two top-floor suites feature sky-high terraces.

[hotel]

[hotel]

[[image]][12] [[image]][13] [[image]][14]

## Sharing moments

Beneath its majestic glass roof, the lounge at Hotel Balzac welcomes Parisians and travelers from
around the world for a break during a day of shopping, a lunch with friends, or a discreet meeting.
Nestled in an alcove, the Hotel Balzac bar hosts night owls who write the story of Paris, from
rendezvous to reunions.

[Explore][15]
[image]

### Spa Ikoi

Designed to offer unique moments of escape with a holistic approach directly inspired by traditional
Japanese methods, the Ikoi Spa at Hotel Balzac provides a range of treatments and massages on tables
or tatami mats. The pool, sauna, and state-of-the-art fitness room complete the facilities of this
unparalleled spa.

[Book your spa moment][16]

### Paris moments News & offers

[hotel]

### Family offer

Enjoy a family stay just steps from the Champs-Élysées by reserving our connecting rooms: a Boudoir
Room connected to a Superior Room for up to 4 guests, or to a Junior Suite for up to 5 guests. Take
advantage of this exceptional offer, which includes a 30% discount on the Boudoir Room, along with
daily breakfasts included. Offer valid for stays of 3 nights or more, from April 14th to May 8th
2025, from July 15th to August 31st 2025, and from November 1st 2025, to March 31st 2026, excluding
holiday periods and Fashion Weeks. Subject to availability. The discount is already reflected in the
displayed rate.

[Book now][17]
[hotel]

### Hôtel Balzac X La Samaritaine

Enjoy an exclusive shopping experience! Treat yourself to an exceptional getaway and enjoy a special
escape at La Samaritaine, with a 3-hour private session with a personal stylist in the heart of the
Appartement de La Samaritaine.

[book the experience][18]
[hotel]

### Hotel Balzac by Festen

Charlotte de Tonnac and Hugo Sauzay, the duo behind Festen Architecture, have transformed Hotel
Balzac into a unique destination, blending grand hotel spirit with intimate chic. Inspired by the
hotel's facade and architectural details, they created a distinctive atmosphere while honoring its
history and heritage. From the glass-roofed lounge to the rooms and spa, the spaces offer a cozy and
welcoming ambiance. Neutral tones, clean lines, and refined materials such as wood, velvet, and
natural stone create timeless elegance. Light, considered as a true element of decoration, enhances
the space throughout the day. Custom-made furniture, reminiscent of the 1930s and 40s, is
reinterpreted with creative modernity and a constant focus on comfort. Every detail of this
renovation echoes Balzac's Parisian identity. "Balzac perpetuates a timeless Parisian hotel heritage
with its classicism. It's a place full of atmosphere, with a history that we have respected and
extended. You need to experience this place to understand it," say Charlotte de Tonnac and Hugo
Sauzay.

Chapter One

## The K-Drama You Can Step Into

Sampaloc Street · San Antonio Village · Makati City

Long before K-pop became a global currency and K-dramas turned the jjimjilbang into one of the
most-searched travel experiences on the internet, New Lasema Spa was already doing the real thing in
the heart of Makati. Opened on Sampaloc Street at the corner of Estrella — inside a corner building
that doubles as a Korean convenience store, restaurant, and salon — Lasema brought to the
Philippines something that had no local equivalent: an authentic, full-service Korean bathhouse
where you check in for the morning and leave, hours later, feeling genuinely different in your skin.

The jjimjilbang tradition in Korea is less spa and more civic institution — a place of democratic
relaxation where office workers, grandparents, and students share steam, hot pools, and borrowed
time in equal measure. Lasema imports that spirit faithfully. You check in, receive your key and
your uniform (the signature loose-fitting jjimjilbang outfit), and begin to move through a series of
thermal experiences that have no real Western parallel: five herbal pools each scented differently,
a salt sauna, a clay kiln, a charcoal room, an ice room, and, at the top of the building, sleeping
caves where guests genuinely nap for hours.

It is not a luxury spa in the Ayala Avenue sense. It is something more interesting: a place with
soul, regularity, and the particular warmth of an institution that knows exactly what it is and why
people keep coming back.

hydrating and refreshing action to restore suppleness & hydration to the skin.

spirit of modern life. Influences of the east are reflected within the décor of uniqe Thai modern

adorn the [historical area][54].

20,000 square meters of pure serenity: 10 herbal pools, 6 onsen pools, 2 saunas, and more…

## **Our Facilities**

## SPA

Your entry ticket includes a complimentary towel and access to all areas until 8 PM, along with
lockers and showers.

## Sauna

Our two-room sauna offers a calming space to detox, improve circulation, and support overall
wellbeing

## MASSAGE

Two open-air salas designed for traditional Thai and oil massages, surrounded by forest

## Herbal Pools

Turmeric Pool, Green Tea Pool, Coffee Pool, Cucumber Pool, Ice Bath, and our signature Tom Yum Pool

### Thai Massage

## What we offer

Set across 12 rai (20,000 sq.m.), Mantra Forest Spa is Southern Thailand’s largest wellness retreat.
Each zone is crafted as part of a sensory journey – from herbal pools and immersive onsen to our
one-of-a-kind signature Tom Yum Pool.

Serene corners invite you to relax, explore, and capture memorable moments, while nature’s embrace
offers both profound therapeutic benefits and a peaceful escape.

[ Read more ][12]

##### A great place to diversify your beach holiday. I really liked the variety of baths: I
##### especially remember the aromatic lavender, the unusual tom yum bath with lemongrass and the
##### relaxing mud baths. The sauna is at the perfect temperature, the pool is clean, there are
##### showers of different configurations and even a hydromassage waterfall for additional
##### relaxation.

## LIZA MEDVEDEVA

##### IMPECCABLY DESIGNED AND DEEPLY RESTORATIVE — EVERY DETAIL, FROM THE HERB-INFUSED POOLS TO THE

## FAQ

[ What is included with the entry ticket? ][13]

Entrance fee includes full-day access and complimentary towel rental

[ Where are you located and how can we get there? ][14]

We’re located in Phang Nga, just outside Phuket, only 5 minutes from the world-famous Samet Nangshe
Viewpoint.

Simply search ‘Mantra Forest Spa’ on Google Maps and you’ll find us.

[ Do children enter for free? ][15]

Children aged 4–12 years are priced at 990 THB per child

[ What types of massage do you offer? ][16]

At Mantra, we offer two open-air salas nestled in the forest, designed for traditional Thai and oil
massages. We recommend booking in advance as availability is on a first-come, first-served basis. To
reserve your massage, please contact us via WhatsApp or Line

[ What time do you close? ][17]

We’re open daily, all year round, from 9 AM to 8 PM

[ How can i book my ticket? ][18]

To get instant access to your day pass please book now through Megatix, our official online
ticketing provider. You can find the link at ‘contact us’ page or ‘book your day pass’.

We’re located in Phang Nga, just outside Phuket, only 5 minutes from the world-famous Samet Nangshe

[ Do children enter for free? ][15]

Children aged 4–12 years are priced at 990 THB per child

massages. We recommend booking in advance as availability is on a first-come, first-served basis. To
reserve your massage, please contact us via WhatsApp or Line

ticketing provider. You can find the link at ‘contact us’ page or ‘book your day pass’.

Как забронировать посещение?
Вы можете забронировать удобную дату и время по телефону или через форму обратной связи. Наш
менедже﻿р всё подтвердит.
Что нужно взять с собой?
Всё необходимое (халат, тапочки, полотенца) уже включено в стоимость посещения. Вам нужно взять
только раздельный купальник/плавки и хорошее настроение.
Есть ли у вас парковка?﻿
Да, для наших гостей доступна бесплатная охраняемая парковка.
Можно ли посещать СПА-центр детям?
Да, мы предлагаем специальные программы для де﻿тей. Просим заранее уточнять возраст ребёнка
у менеджера.
У вас есть комна﻿ты отдыха?
Да, после процедур вы можете отдохнуть в нашей уютной зоне отдыха с травяным чаем.
Можно ли арендовать баню без программы?
Нет, аренда бани возможна только в составе комплексной спа-программы. Мы не сдаём баню отдельно,
чтобы сохранить атмосферу полного расслабления и качество сервиса.

SPA салонов для релакса в Саратове предостаточно, но такого, чтобы с хорошим спа-мастером, с

волшебно!

Банщики просто мировые бани и сауны Саратов такого уровня давно ждал.
Атмосфера гармонии и благожелательности тут царит безраздельно.
Очень рекомендую I Гильдию и Охотничью.

### Оксана Р.

Давно искала подходящий СПА салон в своём районе. С уверенностью могу сказать, что таких мастеров
спа в Саратове очень и очень мало. SPA-программы очень интересные, с подругами только сюда теперь и
ходим. Сауна с бассейном тоже не оставит равнодушным никого. Мы были во всех вариантах Купеческих
бань, каждая из них отличается от остальных. Очень чисто, чувствуется забота о гостях!..

### Иван

Лучшая семейная сауна в Саратове. Удобно расположена рядом с Юбилейным, добираемся быстро и без
пробок. В сауне чисто и уютно.

### Дарья

Замечательное место! Были в 1 гильдиии

Чистый бассейн - то что надо после парилки 👍
Отдельного внимания заслуживает наличие разных травяных чаев и бутилированной воды для гостей !
Приятный персонал и администратор Ксения оч отзывчивая )) Мастер СПА Артур - просто выше всех
похвал!

Остались очень довольны. Рекомендую.

### SPA-услуги


Ищете лучший спа-салон в Саратове для всей семьи?
Нашу бани со спа — место, где царит настоящая чистота, порядок и спокойствие.
У нас нет сомнительных компаний — ведь в «Купеческие бани» приходят семьями и те, кто ценит
серьёзный, достойный отдых.

Мы специально создали атмосферу, в которой комфортно всем — и взрослым, и детям.
Никаких посторонних запахов, громкой музыки и лишних людей. Только чистота, тишина и забота о Вашем
здоровье.

— от “Приветственного пара” до “Медовой маски” и “Мыльного пиллинга”.

Отзывы

### Что говорят о нас гости?

Ваша обратная связь - очень важна для нас! Мы читаем каждый отзыв и делаем наш сказочный сервис
лучше с каждым днем.

### Инна К.

SPA салонов для релакса в Саратове предостаточно, но такого, чтобы с хорошим спа-мастером, с
бассейном и настоящей русской баней, единицы! Приходим сюда с мужем, тут отличные программы для
двоих. Особенно рекомендуем мастера Амана, он просто гуру процедур и настоящего, целебного пара!

### Елена Р.

Стала счастливым обладателем подарочного сертификата на СПА в Купеческие бани. На выходных решила
сходить, и это была феерия! Очень понравилась атмосфера и работа СПА-мастера, всё было просто
волшебно!

### Константин

Банщики просто мировые бани и сауны Саратов такого уровня давно ждал.
Атмосфера гармонии и благожелательности тут царит безраздельно.
Очень рекомендую I Гильдию и Охотничью.

### Оксана Р.

Давно искала подходящий СПА салон в своём районе. С уверенностью могу сказать, что таких мастеров
спа в Саратове очень и очень мало. SPA-программы очень интересные, с подругами только сюда теперь и
ходим. Сауна с бассейном тоже не оставит равнодушным никого. Мы были во всех вариантах Купеческих
бань, каждая из них отличается от остальных. Очень чисто, чувствуется забота о гостях!..

### Иван

Лучшая семейная сауна в Саратове. Удобно расположена рядом с Юбилейным, добираемся быстро и без
пробок. В сауне чисто и уютно.

### Дарья

Замечательное место! Были в 1 гильдиии
Чисто, красиво, парная супер - специальная печь, которая постепенно выдаёт мелкодисперсный пар!
Чистый бассейн - то что надо после парилки 👍
Отдельного внимания заслуживает наличие разных травяных чаев и бутилированной воды для гостей !
Приятный персонал и администратор Ксения оч отзывчивая )) Мастер СПА Артур - просто выше всех
похвал!

### Никита Семёнов

Посетил Крестьянскую баню с веником. Парилка достаточно просторная, можно спокойно в ней лечь даже
высокому человеку. Очень демократичная цена, сушки и чай бесплатно, в номере чайник. Рядом с домом,
что особенно важно.

### Ольга Тиханина

Отличная семейная баня. Были в охотничьей, все продумано до мелочей, красивый интерьер, чисто.
Разнообразные банные веники. Вода, чай травяной. Много места. Купель прям на выходе из парилки.
Остались очень довольны. Рекомендую.

### Игорь Соловьев

Отличное место для отдыха. Чисто, уютно, вежливый и дружелюбный персонал. Отличные банные веники с
разными травами. Можно заказать температуру в парилке и замочить веники в бане заранее к вашему
визиту.

## here, the ocean is still wild. the beaches uncrowded. the heritage alive.

South Caicos is not about crowds—it’s about connection. With nature. With culture. With yourself. On
the quiet shores of South Caicos, Salterra Resort & Spa offers a rare kind of luxury. It is measured
not in excess, but in stillness, space, and a feeling of belonging to something untouched.
